gaps: ProductDetail receives list item data, not full detail data from GET /k/products/{id}.

No UI for attributes, translations, DeepSeek enrichment, risk-filter AI trigger, media, review items, versions, or downstream export.

as_built: Risk table supports edit, resolve, and ignore actions.

AI risk-filter endpoint is not exposed in UI.

SERP results are not one-click promoted into keyword entries.
